_comment: Default bindings for the two pads. Player 1 on the keyboard as the decompilation's own Settings.ini has it - the arrows,
A, S and D for A, B and C, Q, W and E for X, Y and Z, Enter for Start, Tab for Select - and on the first pad; player 2 on the second pad.
Dev Menu is Escape, as the decompilation opens its developer menu. Y and Z are also on the controller's shoulders.

Sonic Origins.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV0U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Sonic Origins.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV0D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Sonic Origins.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV0L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Sonic Origins.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV0R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
Sonic Origins.P2 Up: J2 POV0U, X2 DpadUp, X2 LStickUp
Sonic Origins.P2 Down: J2 POV0D, X2 DpadDown, X2 LStickDown
Sonic Origins.P2 Left: J2 POV0L, X2 DpadLeft, X2 LStickLeft
Sonic Origins.P2 Right: J2 POV0R, X2 DpadRight, X2 LStickRight
